Post Title: ABT-VS-LP-23 23 Cu. Ft. Premier Glass Door Laboratory Refrigerator
product_title: 23 Cu. Ft. Premier Glass Door Laboratory Refrigerator
summary:
The ABT-VS-LP-23 delivers exceptional temperature performance through advanced variable speed compressor technology and precise microprocessor control. With maximum temperature variation of just +/- 1.5°C in cabinet air and remarkable stability of +/- 0.3°C using simulator ballast, this 23 cubic foot laboratory refrigerator ensures your critical samples remain within strict parameters. The unit’s patented forced draft air circulation technology and EPA-compliant R600a hydrocarbon refrigerant combine to achieve ultra-low energy consumption of less than 1.2 KWh per day while meeting ENERGY STAR v2.0 standards.

Engineered for demanding clinical and research environments, the ABT-VS-LP-23 features comprehensive monitoring capabilities with audible and visual alarms for temperature excursions, sensor errors, power failures, and door ajar conditions. The digital temperature display offers C°/F° switchable readouts with 0.1°C resolution, while remote alarm contacts enable integration with facility monitoring systems. A keyed door lock provides immediate security, with compatibility for optional digital locks including Pyxis, Omnicell, and AcuDose RX systems.

Built to withstand continuous laboratory use, the ABT-VS-LP-23 combines a durable white powder-coated steel exterior with high-density urethane foam insulation for optimal efficiency. The self-closing glass door with magnetic gasket minimizes temperature fluctuations, while safety-shielded LED interior lighting and four adjustable shelves maximize usability. With swivel casters including locking front units for easy positioning, plus a generous 2-year parts and labor warranty backed by a 7-year compressor warranty, this premier refrigerator delivers long-term reliability for your most valuable specimens.

Key Features

  • Variable speed compressor technology with microprocessor temperature control
  • 23 cubic foot capacity with adjustable temperature range of 2°C to 15°C
  • ENERGY STAR v2.0 compliant with <1.2 KWh/day energy consumption
  • Four adjustable shelves with half-inch increment positioning
  • ETL and C-ETL listed with 7-year compressor warranty

Benefits

  • Achieve +/- 0.3°C stability to protect temperature-sensitive samples and reagents
  • Reduce operating costs with ultra-low energy consumption and natural refrigerant
  • Maintain compliance with comprehensive alarm system and remote monitoring capability
  • Maximize storage flexibility with 23 cu ft capacity and adjustable shelving
  • Ensure long-term reliability with 7-year compressor warranty coverage
  • Integrate seamlessly with existing security systems via digital lock compatibility

summary:
Transform your sample storage with the ABT-HC-1786-TS ultra-low temperature freezer, engineered to protect your most valuable research materials with precision and reliability down to -86°C. This 17 cubic foot system combines cutting-edge variable speed compressor technology with practical design. The dual voltage capability with included 120V and 240V power cords ensures seamless installation in any laboratory environment, while heavy-duty locking casters provide secure yet flexible positioning.

The ABT-HC-1786-TS puts complete control at your fingertips through its intuitive 11-inch color touchscreen interface, enabling real-time temperature monitoring, comprehensive data logging, and trend analysis for regulatory compliance. Customizable audible and visual alarms with adjustable delays and ring-back functionality ensure you never miss a critical event, while the 4-20mA output enables integration with facility monitoring systems. During power interruptions, the high-capacity 12V battery backup maintains all monitoring, alarming, and data logging functions to safeguard your research.

Designed for maximum efficiency and sustainability, the ABT-HC-1786-TS utilizes natural hydrocarbon refrigerants in dual variable-speed compressors that deliver exceptional performance at just 0.59 kWh/day/cu.ft. The powder-coated steel construction houses four adjustable stainless steel shelves supporting up to 160 pounds each, accommodating 320 standard 2-inch storage boxes. With comprehensive 5-year parts and labor and 7-year compressor warranties, this freezer will protect your research for years to come.

Key Features

  • Variable speed compressor technology
  • Intuitive color touchscreen display
  • Five insulated inner doors maintain temperature stability during access
  • Natural hydrocarbon refrigerants for sustainable operation
  • Stores 320 standard 2-inch boxes across four 160-pound capacity shelves

Benefits

  • Simplify installation with dual voltage capability
  • Maintain sample integrity with five inner doors minimizing temperature loss
  • Track compliance effortlessly through comprehensive data logging and export features
  • Enhance energy efficiency using natural hydrocarbon refrigerants
  • Maximize laboratory space with 320 box capacity in 17 cubic foot footprint
  • Enjoy a protective 5-year parts and labor warranty alongside a 7-year compressor warranty

Agency Listing and Certification UL/C-UL listed. Certified to UL 60335-2-89 Safety Standard
tab_2_content:
Vacuum Relief Port: Includes heated vacuum relief port for pressure equalization reducing wait times between door openings
Average heat rejection (BTU/h): 1602 BTU/h
Energy Consumption (kWh/Day/CUFT) As low as 0.59 kWh/day/cu.ft.
Adjustable Temperature Range -86°C to -50°C
Warm-up times: 180+ minutes -80°C to -50°C°
Refrigerant R290 / R170
Energy Consumption (KWh/day) As low as 0.59 kWh/day/cu.ft.
Evaporator: Cold wall (Natural convection)
Compressor: Two ea. variable speed hermetic reciprocating
Condenser: Tube and Fin design, EC fan, easy clean removable filter
tab_3_content:
Controller technology Microprocessor with color touchscreen (11in) input and display, C° or F°
Battery Backup 12V high capacity battery for controller and touchscreen display: temperature monitoring, alarms, and event logging active
External alarm connection State switching remote alarm contacts
Digital Communication 4-20mA output for temperature monitoring
Alarms  

Audible and Visual Alarms: customizable sounds and volumes; mute with visual persistence; ring-back functionality re-engages audible alarm

after pre-set delay if alarm condition persists. Adjustable delays for door, temperature, power loss.
Disclaimers Indoor use only, +18C to +26C (+65F to +78F), <70% RH.  Specifications are subject to change. Backup battery maintains display,

data logging, and alarms. Cooling capability is not maintained without external generator.
Optional Accessories Removable storage racks, Precision fit rack system (in place of shelves), storage boxes, Wi-Fi data logger, additional shelves,

additional chamber temperature (sample) probe.

product_title: Waterproof Gloves, Elbow Length
product_id: ABS CG EB S WP, ABS CG EB M WP, ABS CG EB L WP, ABS CG EB XL WP
summary:
American BioTech Supply’s line of gloves for cryogenic applications are manufactured in two configurations: Standard Series Water Repellent and 100% Waterproof Series.  The Standard Series is recommended for use where the protection requirement is mainly against cold as opposed to protection against splashing or dripping liquid, in which case the Waterproof Series would be recommended. The sequence of insulating layers is the same for both series of gloves. This consists of three layers: two layers of insulation material are bonded together at the edges of each piece enabling insulating air to be trapped without adding additional weight or bulk and is then complimented with an inner lining that adds insulating value and is specifically designed to wick moisture away from the skin. The Waterproof Series gloves incorporate a thin seamless, 100% waterproof inner protective layer. The Wrist style gloves on both Series also incorporates an uninsulated knit cuff.

Under no circumstances should any of these gloves be submerged directly in liquid nitrogen or used with liquid oxygen.

Sizing: Waterproof gloves are available in four sizes: Small, Medium, Large and Extra Large. These four sizes correspond to European and American sizes of 8, 9, 10 and 11. They are available in Wrist, Mid-Arm, Elbow and Shoulder lengths.

Post Title: PH-ABT-HC-S72S 72 Cu. Ft. Standard Pharmacy Solid Door Refrigerator
product_title: 72 Cu. Ft. Standard Pharmacy Solid Door Refrigerator
summary:
Replaces Part #: PH-ABT-S72S

The Pharmacy Standard Solid Door Pharmacy Refrigerators are purpose built for pharmacy and medical applications. The new Standard Solid Door Pharmacy Refrigerators feature a digital microprocessor temperature controller allowing for the precise temperature management necessary for critical samples and supplies.

A forced air directional refrigeration system provides superior temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. An automatic cycle-defrost design prevents product damaging temperature spikes.

The temperature display and alarm module offers product security with a monitoring and alarm system. Real-time sample simulated temperatures are constantly displayed and supported by audible/visual high and low temperature alarms. Remote alarm dry contacts and an access port are provided to simplify connections to existing facility monitoring systems

For more information on Vaccine Storage: Vaccine Storage

The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C and 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F and 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in freezers.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

summary:
The Premier Pharmacy Dual Temp Combination units feature separate microprocessor temperature controller allowing for precise temperature control, verification and recovery. An interior fan driven, forced-draft air circulation system provides excellent temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. REFRIGERATORS ONLY

The Premier Pharmacy Built In Undercounter Freezers feature a microprocessor temperature controller and display, allow for precise temperature control, verification and recovery versus mechanical style thermostats. Critical samples and supplies are security backed with an extensive package of audible and visual alarms.

Periodic defrosting is required.

The Built-In models are designed with a “front breathing” ventilation system, eliminating the need for clearance around the top and sides of the unit; enabling the user to incorporate these units into cabinets and other applications where free space is limited.
Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

For more information on Vaccine Storage: Vaccine Storage

The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C to 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F to 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in the freezer.

product_title: KryoVault System, 41,600 Vials Polycarbonate Package System
summary:
The ABS KryoVault is engineered to provide cryogenic temperatures throughout the tank well below the critical -135°C range. With only a few inches of liquid, vapor temperatures approaching the actual -196°C temperature of LN₂  can be maintained at the highest shelf. The unique restricted neck opening design, with double-hinged lid, brings liquid consumption to one of the lowest rates in the industry.

Every KryoVault System comes standard with: 6ft. stainless-steel armor-plated transfer hose, 1/3 parts and labor warranty, casters, folding step, inventory carousel, keyed lid lock, LN2 measuring rod, flat stainless-steel work surface and the Sentry Plus LN₂ Controller.

KryoVault package systems include: KryoVault Tank, Sentry Plus LN₂ Controller, stainless steel rack inventory system, transfer hose, CryoGloves, LN₂ measuring rod, and either fiberboard boxes (25 cell, 81 cell, 100 cell, or custom) or polycarbonate boxes (25 cell, 81 cell, or 100 cell).

**

These standard upright refrigerators are designed in accordance with the NSF/ANSI 456 Standard for Vaccine Storage. Refrigerators protect pharmaceuticals at optimal temperatures, preventing waste and allowing for peak delivery.

These glass door refrigerators utilize microprocessor controllers and feature temperature alarms, remote alarm contacts, LED interior lighting, and probe access ports. American Biotech Supply Vaccine Storage Refrigerators utilize HFC-free refrigerant for environmental health and energy efficiency.

Post Title: ABT-HC-10PS 10.5 Cu. Ft. Premier Compact Solid Door Laboratory Refrigerator
product_title: 10.5 Cu. Ft. Premier Compact Solid Door Laboratory Refrigerator
summary:
Transform your laboratory’s sample storage capabilities with the ABT-HC-10PS compact refrigerator, a premier solid door unit that safeguards your valuable specimens while reducing energy costs. This ENERGY STAR certified refrigerator consumes only 2.42 kWh per day, delivering significant operational savings without compromising the precise 1°C to 10°C temperature control your sensitive materials demand. The comprehensive monitoring system includes dual probes tracking both air and sample temperatures, plus audible and visual alarms that alert staff immediately to any temperature excursions.

The ABT-HC-10PS compact refrigerator maximizes your laboratory’s efficiency with its thoughtfully designed 10.5 cubic foot interior featuring six adjustable shelves with protective guard rails. Each shelf can be customized to accommodate various sample sizes, while the bottom footed shelf ensures proper airflow throughout the chamber. The forced draft circulation system works continuously with the back wall evaporator cover to maintain uniform conditions, protecting every sample regardless of its position within the unit.

Built to deliver years of reliable service, the ABT-HC-10PS compact refrigerator features a robust powder coat exterior finish and high-density urethane foam insulation for superior temperature retention. The solid door includes a magnetic gasket for an airtight seal and a keyed lock for security. LED interior lighting provides clear visibility without adding heat. With sustainable hydrocarbon refrigerant and comprehensive warranty coverage—two years parts and labor plus three additional years on the compressor—this unit represents a smart investment in your laboratory’s future.

Key Features

  • Microprocessor temperature control
  • Audible and visual alarms with remote alarm contacts
  • Natural hydrocarbon refrigerants

Benefits

  • Reduce energy costs with ENERGY STAR certified 2.42 kWh/day consumption
  • Protect valuable samples with precise 1°C to 10°C temperature control
  • Ensure compliance with dual probe monitoring and comprehensive alarm systems
  • Support sustainability initiatives with hydrocarbon refrigerant
  • Integrate seamlessly into existing monitoring systems via remote alarm contacts
  • Maintain sample integrity with forced draft circulation and uniform cooling

product_title: 10 Cu. Ft. Pharmacy Refrigerator & Freezer (-40°F Operation) Combination, with Glass Door Refrigerator
summary:
The Premier Pharmacy Dual Temp Combination units feature separate microprocessor temperature controller allowing for precise temperature control, verification and recovery. An interior fan driven, forced-draft air circulation system provides excellent temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. REFRIGERATORS ONLY

All models are equipped with digital temperature displays for convenient monitoring. Critical samples and supplies are security backed with an extensive package of audible and visual alarms. The freezer units feature either an automatic or manual defrost operating system. For manual defrost freezers, periodic manual defrosting is required.

This model requires 4” of clearance around back and sides of the unit for proper ventilation. Improper installation will void the warranty and will lead to temperature maintenance issues, overheating and possible failure.

For more information on Vaccine Storage: Vaccine Storage

The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C and 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F and 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in freezers.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

Post Title: ABS CG MA S, ABS CG MA M, ABS CG MA L, ABS CG MA XL Standard Water Resistant Gloves, Mid Arm Length
product_title: Standard Water Resistant Gloves, Mid Arm Length
product_id: ABS CG MA S, ABS CG MA M, ABS CG MA L, ABS CG MA XL
summary:
American BioTech Supply’s line of gloves for cryogenic applications are manufactured in two configurations: Standard Series Water Repellent and 100% Waterproof Series.  The Standard Series is recommended for use where the protection requirement is mainly against cold as opposed to protection against splashing or dripping liquid, in which case the Waterproof Series would be recommended. The sequence of insulating layers is the same for both series of gloves. This consists of three layers: two layers of insulation material are bonded together at the edges of each piece enabling insulating air to be trapped without adding additional weight or bulk and is then complimented with an inner lining that adds insulating value and is specifically designed to wick moisture away from the skin. The Waterproof Series gloves incorporate a thin seamless, 100% waterproof inner protective layer. The Wrist style gloves on both Series also incorporates an uninsulated knit cuff.

Under no circumstances should any of these gloves be submerged directly in liquid nitrogen or used with liquid oxygen.

Sizing: CryoGuard gloves are available in four sizes: Small, Medium, Large and Extra Large. These four sizes correspond to European and American sizes of 8, 9, 10 and 11. They are available in Wrist, Mid-Arm, Elbow and Shoulder lengths.

Post Title: KVP-4 KryoVault System, 94,500 Vials
product_title: KryoVault System, 94,500 Vials
summary:
The ABS KryoVault is engineered to provide cryogenic temperatures throughout the tank well below the critical -135°C range. With only a few inches of liquid, vapor temperatures approaching the actual -196°C temperature of LN₂  can be maintained at the highest shelf. The unique restricted neck opening design, with double-hinged lid, brings liquid consumption to one of the lowest rates in the industry. 

Every KryoVault System comes standard with: 6ft. stainless-steel armor-plated transfer hose, 1/3 parts and labor warranty, casters, folding step, inventory carousel, keyed lid lock, LN2 measuring rod, flat stainless-steel work surface and the Sentry Plus LN₂ Controller.

KryoVault package systems include: KryoVault Tank, Sentry Plus LN₂ Controller, stainless steel rack inventory system, transfer hose, CryoGloves, LN₂ measuring rod, and either fiberboard boxes (25 cell, 81 cell, 100 cell, or custom) or polycarbonate boxes (25 cell, 81 cell, or 100 cell).

* *

These premier upright refrigerators are designed in accordance with the NSF/ANSI 456 Standard for Vaccine Storage. Refrigerators protect pharmaceuticals at optimal temperatures, preventing waste and allowing for peak delivery.

product_title: KryoVault System, 41,600 Vials
summary:
The ABS KryoVault is engineered to provide cryogenic temperatures throughout the tank well below the critical -135°C range. With only a few inches of liquid, vapor temperatures approaching the actual -196°C temperature of LN₂  can be maintained at the highest shelf. The unique restricted neck opening design, with double-hinged lid, brings liquid consumption to one of the lowest rates in the industry. 

Every KryoVault System comes standard with: 6ft. stainless-steel armor-plated transfer hose, 1/3 parts and labor warranty, casters, folding step, inventory carousel, keyed lid lock, LN2 measuring rod, flat stainless-steel work surface and the Sentry Plus LN₂ Controller.

KryoVault package systems include: KryoVault Tank, Sentry Plus LN₂ Controller, stainless steel rack inventory system, transfer hose, CryoGloves, LN₂ measuring rod, and either fiberboard boxes (25 cell, 81 cell, 100 cell, or custom) or polycarbonate boxes (25 cell, 81 cell, or 100 cell).

product_title: 17 Cu. Ft. General Purpose Auto Defrost Hydrocarbon Laboratory Freezer
summary:
Auto-Defrost Freezers are ideal for industrial, clinical, or research laboratory requirements. Designed to provide dependable, energy-efficient performance, all units are manufactured with CFC-free high-density urethane foam cabinet and door insulation to maintain temperature stability.

Auto-Defrost design provides the convenience of a frost-free interior. However, chamber air temperatures do experience a moderate rise during defrost cycles.

Defrosting of the unit will need to be performed periodically to prevent severe ice build-up.

product_title: 30 Cu. Ft. TempLog Premier Flammable Storage Freezer
summary:
The TempLog Premier Flammable Storage Freezers Meet NFPA and OSHA guidelines 45 and 70 for the refrigerated storage of flammable (volatile) materials in general laboratory work areas. There are no electrical components located in the interior of the unit and the compressor’s electrical components have been sealed in a vapor-proof enclosure for additional safety.

These units are NOT designed for use in environments where volatile/explosive conditions could potentially exist.

The Touch Screen temperature display and alarm module offers industry-leading product security real-time sample simulated temperatures are constantly displayed, logged and supported by audible/visual alarms, remote alarm contacts, a 4-20mA output and an access port. A USB port is provided for easy data transfer.

Defrosting of the unit will need to be performed periodically to prevent severe ice build-up.

These premier countertop refrigerators are designed in accordance with the NSF/ANSI 456 Standard for Vaccine Storage. Refrigerators protect pharmaceuticals at optimal temperatures, preventing waste and allowing for peak delivery.

These solid door freestanding refrigerators utilize microprocessor controllers and feature temperature alarms, remote alarm contacts, LED interior lighting, and probe access ports with included probes. The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C and 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F and 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in freezers.

Post Title: KVP-3 PS KryoVault System, 79,300 Vials Polycarbonate Package System
product_title: KryoVault System, 79,300 Vials Polycarbonate Package System
summary:
The ABS KryoVault is engineered to provide cryogenic temperatures throughout the tank well below the critical -135°C range. product_title: 10.5 Cu. Ft. Premier Glass Door Compact Laboratory Refrigerator
summary:
Transform your laboratory storage capabilities with the ABT-HC-10PG compact refrigerator, a premier glass door solution that combines visibility, security, and energy efficiency in a space-saving design. With 10.5 Cu. Ft. of temperature-controlled storage and six adjustable shelves, this unit maximizes your laboratory’s organizational potential while maintaining strict temperature parameters. The glass door design eliminates unnecessary door openings for inventory checks, reducing temperature fluctuations and energy waste while saving valuable time.

The ABT-HC-10PG compact refrigerator safeguards your investment with comprehensive monitoring and alarm systems that protect against temperature excursions. A digital temperature display with a sample simulated probe provides instant verification of storage conditions, while audible and visual alarms alert staff to any deviations from the 1°C to 10°C set range. Remote alarm contacts enable 24/7 monitoring integration, ensuring round-the-clock monitoring for valuable samples and reagents.

Built for sustainability and long-term value, the ABT-HC-10PG compact refrigerator features ENERGY STAR certification and uses only 2.42 kWh per day, reducing your facility’s carbon footprint and utility costs. This unit employs environmentally friendly HFC-free refrigerant (R600a) and comes backed by a comprehensive warranty including two years parts and labor plus three additional years on compressor parts. High-density urethane foam insulation and powder coat exterior construction ensure years of reliable service in demanding laboratory environments.

Key Features

  • Microprocessor temperature control
  • Audible and visual high/low temperature alarms with remote contacts
  • Natural hydrocarbon refrigerants

Benefits

  • Glass door visibility reduces door openings and maintains temperature stability
  • ENERGY STAR certification lowers operating costs and environmental impact
  • Remote alarm capability enables 24/7 monitoring of valuable samples
  • Adjustable 1°C to 10°C range accommodates diverse storage requirements
  • Compact footprint maximizes lab space utilization
  • Natural refrigerants support sustainability initiatives and regulatory compliance

Post Title: ABS CG WR S WP, ABS CG WR M WP, ABS CG WR L WP, ABS CG WR XL WP Waterproof Gloves, Wrist Length
product_title: Waterproof Gloves, Wrist Length
product_id: ABS CG WR S WP, ABS CG WR M WP, ABS CG WR L WP, ABS CG WR XL WP
summary:
American BioTech Supply’s line of gloves for cryogenic applications are manufactured in two configurations: Standard Series Water Repellent and 100% Waterproof Series.  The Standard Series is recommended for use where the protection requirement is mainly against cold as opposed to protection against splashing or dripping liquid, in which case the Waterproof Series would be recommended. The sequence of insulating layers is the same for both series of gloves. This consists of three layers: two layers of insulation material are bonded together at the edges of each piece enabling insulating air to be trapped without adding additional weight or bulk and is then complimented with an inner lining that adds insulating value and is specifically designed to wick moisture away from the skin. The Waterproof Series gloves incorporate a thin seamless, 100% waterproof inner protective layer. The Wrist style gloves on both Series also incorporates an uninsulated knit cuff.

Under no circumstances should any of these gloves be submerged directly in liquid nitrogen or used with liquid oxygen.

Sizing: Waterproof gloves are available in four sizes: Small, Medium, Large and Extra Large. These four sizes correspond to European and American sizes of 8, 9, 10 and 11. They are available in Wrist, Mid-Arm, Elbow and Shoulder lengths.

product_title: Waterproof Gloves, Shoulder Length

summary:
American BioTech Supply’s line of gloves for cryogenic applications are manufactured in two configurations: Standard Series Water Repellent and 100% Waterproof Series.  The Standard Series is recommended for use where the protection requirement is mainly against cold as opposed to protection against splashing or dripping liquid, in which case the Waterproof Series would be recommended. The sequence of insulating layers is the same for both series of gloves. This consists of three layers: two layers of insulation material are bonded together at the edges of each piece enabling insulating air to be trapped without adding additional weight or bulk and is then complimented with an inner lining that adds insulating value and is specifically designed to wick moisture away from the skin. The Waterproof Series gloves incorporate a thin seamless, 100% waterproof inner protective layer. The Wrist style gloves on both Series also incorporates an uninsulated knit cuff.

Under no circumstances should any of these gloves be submerged directly in liquid nitrogen or used with liquid oxygen.

Sizing: Waterproof gloves are available in four sizes: Small, Medium, Large and Extra Large. These four sizes correspond to European and American sizes of 8, 9, 10 and 11. They are available in Wrist, Mid-Arm, Elbow and Shoulder lengths.

summary:

Flammable storage freezers meet the requirements of NFPA 45 and NFPA 30 for cold storage of flammable and combustible materials in unclassified laboratory locations. Utilizes non-sparking and/or ATEX rated components to ensure an intrinsically safe interior for flammable materials in sealed containers. These units feature temperature alarms, keyed door locks, interior shelving, probe access, and microprocessor temperature control.

Models utilize environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) which vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL or ETL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

Please Note: For manual defrost freezers, periodic manual defrosting is required.  Freestanding models require 4″ of clearance around back and sides of unit for proper ventilation.

summary:
The Premier Built In  Undercounter Refrigerators feature a microprocessor temperature controller and display, which allows for precise temperature control, verification and recovery versus mechanical style thermostats.

The 4.6 cu. ft capacity laboratory grade refrigerator is ideal where space is at a premium in laboratory and research environments. This laboratory refrigerator meets ADA compliance with a total height of under 32 inches making it easily wheelchair accessible. The ADA-compliant refrigerator has all the features required for laboratory safety and security for critical cold storage in laboratory refrigeration and medical refrigeration applications.

The Built-In models are designed with a “front breathing” ventilation system, eliminating the need for clearance around the top and sides of the unit; enabling the user to incorporate these units into cabinets and other applications where free space is limited.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

The ABS KryoVault is engineered to provide cryogenic temperatures throughout the tank well below the critical -135°C range. Post Title: PH-ABT-HC-RFC12A 12 Cu. Ft. Pharmacy Refrigerator and Auto Defrost Freezer Combination
product_title: 12 Cu. Ft. Pharmacy Refrigerator and Auto Defrost Freezer Combination
summary:
The Premier Pharmacy Dual Temp Combination units feature separate microprocessor temperature controller allowing for precise temperature control, verification and recovery. An interior fan driven, forced-draft air circulation system provides excellent temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. REFRIGERATORS ONLY

All models are equipped with digital temperature displays for convenient monitoring. Critical samples and supplies are security backed with an extensive package of audible and visual alarms. The freezer units feature either an automatic or manual defrost operating system. For manual defrost freezers, periodic manual defrosting is required.

This model requires 4” of clearance around back and sides of the unit for proper ventilation. Improper installation will void the warranty and will lead to temperature maintenance issues, overheating and possible failure.

DISCLAIMER: Auto defrost freezers incorporate an electric heater installed on the evaporator that assist in the removal of the frost and ice. Although the heater helps speed up the frost and ice removal, it can raise the temperatures within the freezer.

For more information on Vaccine Storage: Vaccine Storage

The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C and 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F and 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in freezers.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

Post Title: ABT-HC-RFC9-LH 9 Cu. Ft. Refrigerator and Freezer Combination-Left Hinged
product_title: 9 Cu. Ft. Refrigerator and Freezer Combination-Left Hinged
summary:
The Premier Dual Temp Combination units feature separate microprocessor temperature controller allowing for precise temperature control, verification and recovery. An interior fan driven, forced-draft air circulation system provides excellent temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. REFRIGERATORS ONLY

All models are equipped with digital temperature displays for convenient monitoring. Critical samples and supplies are security backed with an extensive package of audible and visual alarms. The freezer units feature either an automatic or manual defrost operating system. For manual defrost freezers, periodic manual defrosting is required.

This model is designed with a “front-breathing” ventilation system, eliminating the need for clearance around the top and sides of the unit; enabling the user to incorporate these units into cabinets and other applications where free space is limited.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

product_title: 23 Cu. Ft. Standard Pharmacy Glass Door Refrigerator Certified to NSF/ANSI 456
summary:
**

These standard upright refrigerators are designed in accordance with the NSF/ANSI 456 Standard for Vaccine Storage. Refrigerators protect pharmaceuticals at optimal temperatures, preventing waste and allowing for peak delivery.

These glass door refrigerators utilize microprocessor controllers and feature temperature alarms, remote alarm contacts, LED interior lighting, and probe access ports. American Biotech Supply Vaccine Storage Refrigerators utilize HFC-free refrigerant for environmental health and energy efficiency.

For more information on Vaccine Storage: Vaccine Storage
The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C and 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F and 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in freezers.

Post Title: ABT-HC-CP-36-TS 36 Cu. Ft. TempLog Premier Glass Door Chromatography Refrigerator
product_title: 36 Cu. Ft. TempLog Premier Glass Door Chromatography Refrigerator
summary:
The TempLog Premier Glass door Chromatography Refrigerators are purpose built for scientific and medical applications. Units feature a digital microprocessor temperature controller allowing for the precise temperature management necessary for critical samples and supplies. A forced air directional refrigeration system provides superior temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. An automatic cycle-defrost design prevents product damaging temperature spikes.

The Touch Screen temperature display and alarm module offers the latest in advanced temperature control and data logging. Industry-leading product security with a monitoring and alarm system that is 100% independent of the temperature controller. Real-time sample simulated temperatures are constantly displayed, logged and supported by audible/visual high and low temperature alarms, along with power outage, sensor error and door ajar alarms, remote alarm dry contacts, a 4-20mA output and an access port are provided to simplify connections to existing facility monitoring systems. A USB port is provided for easy transfer as well as software updates.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

summary:
The General Purpose Dual Temperature units meet and exceed the specifications of most general-purpose units, providing both refrigerator and freezer compartments with standard analog dial temperature thermostats. Units are intended for general purpose applications only where precise temperature control and maintenance are not essential and there are no requirements for temperature alarms.

Auto defrost freezer compartments have programmed defrost cycles that will reach air temperatures of approximately 0 degrees Celsius.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

DISCLAIMER: Auto defrost freezers incorporate an electric heater installed on the evaporator that assist in the removal of the frost and ice. Although the heater helps speed up the frost and ice removal, it can raise the temperatures within the freezer.

Post Title: ABS CG WR S, ABS CG WR M, ABS CG WR L, ABS CG WR XL Standard Water Resistant Gloves, Wrist Length
product_title: Standard Water Resistant Gloves, Wrist Length
product_id: ABS CG WR S, ABS CG WR M, ABS CG WR L, ABS CG WR XL
summary:
American BioTech Supply’s line of gloves for cryogenic applications are manufactured in two configurations: Standard Series Water Repellent and 100% Waterproof Series.  The Standard Series is recommended for use where the protection requirement is mainly against cold as opposed to protection against splashing or dripping liquid, in which case the Waterproof Series would be recommended. The sequence of insulating layers is the same for both series of gloves. This consists of three layers: two layers of insulation material are bonded together at the edges of each piece enabling insulating air to be trapped without adding additional weight or bulk and is then complimented with an inner lining that adds insulating value and is specifically designed to wick moisture away from the skin. The Waterproof Series gloves incorporate a thin seamless, 100% waterproof inner protective layer. The Wrist style gloves on both Series also incorporates an uninsulated knit cuff.

Under no circumstances should any of these gloves be submerged directly in liquid nitrogen or used with liquid oxygen.

Sizing: CryoGuard gloves are available in four sizes: Small, Medium, Large and Extra Large. These four sizes correspond to European and American sizes of 8, 9, 10 and 11. They are available in Wrist, Mid-Arm, Elbow and Shoulder lengths.

summary:
The Premier Dual Temp Combination units feature separate microprocessor temperature controller allowing for precise temperature control, verification and recovery. An interior fan driven, forced-draft air circulation system provides excellent temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. REFRIGERATORS ONLY

All models are equipped with digital temperature displays for convenient monitoring. Critical samples and supplies are security backed with an extensive package of audible and visual alarms. The freezer units feature either an automatic or manual defrost operating system. For manual defrost freezers, periodic manual defrosting is required.

This model requires 4” of clearance around back and sides of the unit for proper ventilation. Improper installation will void the warranty and will lead to temperature maintenance issues, overheating and possible failure.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

DISCLAIMER: Auto defrost freezers incorporate an electric heater installed on the evaporator that assist in the removal of the frost and ice. Although the heater helps speed up the frost and ice removal, it can raise the temperatures within the freezer.

Post Title: ABS CG EB S, ABS CG EB M, ABS CG EB L, ABS CG EB XL Standard Water Resistant Gloves, Elbow Length
product_title: Standard Water Resistant Gloves, Elbow Length
product_id: ABS CG EB S, ABS CG EB M, ABS CG EB L, ABS CG EB XL
summary:
American BioTech Supply’s line of gloves for cryogenic applications are manufactured in two configurations: Standard Series Water Repellent and 100% Waterproof Series.  The Standard Series is recommended for use where the protection requirement is mainly against cold as opposed to protection against splashing or dripping liquid, in which case the Waterproof Series would be recommended. The sequence of insulating layers is the same for both series of gloves. This consists of three layers: two layers of insulation material are bonded together at the edges of each piece enabling insulating air to be trapped without adding additional weight or bulk and is then complimented with an inner lining that adds insulating value and is specifically designed to wick moisture away from the skin. The Waterproof Series gloves incorporate a thin seamless, 100% waterproof inner protective layer. The Wrist style gloves on both Series also incorporates an uninsulated knit cuff.

Under no circumstances should any of these gloves be submerged directly in liquid nitrogen or used with liquid oxygen.

Sizing: CryoGuard gloves are available in four sizes: Small, Medium, Large and Extra Large. These four sizes correspond to European and American sizes of 8, 9, 10 and 11. They are available in Wrist, Mid-Arm, Elbow and Shoulder lengths.

product_title: 23 Cu. Ft. Premier Glass Door Laboratory Refrigerator

summary:
The unique fiberglass restricted-opening neck design of the ABS Auto Jr. reduces LN₂consumption rates far below other auto-filling units. Under laboratory testing providing one opening per day, the ABS Auto Jr. operated and maintained “cryogenic temperatures” for over a month on one 180-liter LN₂ supply tank. The Auto Jr is the economical auto-fill for every lab. Every Auto Jr comes standard with: 6ft. stainless-steel armor-plated transfer hose, 1/3 year parts and labor warranty, roller base, stainless steel inventory racks, and the Sentry LN2 controller.

ABS Auto Jr. Fiberboard package systems include: ABS Auto Jr. Tank, Sentry LN2 Controller, stainless steel rack inventory system, transfer hose, CryoGloves, LN₂ measuring rod, and fiberboard boxes (25 cell, 81 cell, 100 cell, or custom).

product_title: 5 Cu. Ft. Standard Undercounter Flammable Storage Freestanding Refrigerator
summary:
The Standard Flammable Storage Refrigerators Meet NFPA and OSHA guidelines 45 and 70 for the refrigerated storage of flammable (volatile) materials in general laboratory work areas. There are no electrical components located in the interior of the unit and the compressor’s electrical components have been sealed in a vapor-proof enclosure for additional safety.

The Standard Freestanding Undercounter Refrigerators feature a microprocessor temperature controller and display, which allows for precise temperature control, verification and recovery versus mechanical style thermostats.

The Freestanding models (“UCFS”) require 4” of clearance around back and sides of the unit for proper ventilation. Improper installation will void the warranty and will lead to temperature maintenance issues, overheating and possible failure.

These units are NOT designed for use in environments where volatile/explosive conditions could potentially exist.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

product_title: 12 Cu. Ft. Pharmacy Refrigerator and Auto Defrost Freezer Combination with Glass Door
summary:
The Premier Pharmacy Dual Temp Combination units feature separate microprocessor temperature controller allowing for precise temperature control, verification and recovery. An interior fan driven, forced-draft air circulation system provides excellent temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. REFRIGERATORS ONLY

All models are equipped with digital temperature displays for convenient monitoring. Critical samples and supplies are security backed with an extensive package of audible and visual alarms. The freezer units feature either an automatic or manual defrost operating system. For manual defrost freezers, periodic manual defrosting is required.

This model requires 4” of clearance around back and sides of the unit for proper ventilation. Improper installation will void the warranty and will lead to temperature maintenance issues, overheating and possible failure.

DISCLAIMER: Auto defrost freezers incorporate an electric heater installed on the evaporator that assist in the removal of the frost and ice. Although the heater helps speed up the frost and ice removal, it can raise the temperatures within the freezer.

For more information on Vaccine Storage: Vaccine Storage

The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C and 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F and 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in freezers.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

summary:

The Pharmacy Standard Solid Door Pharmacy Refrigerators are purpose built for pharmacy and medical applications. The new Standard Solid Door Pharmacy Refrigerators feature a digital microprocessor temperature controller allowing for the precise temperature management necessary for critical samples and supplies.

A forced air directional refrigeration system provides superior temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. An automatic cycle-defrost design prevents product damaging temperature spikes.

The temperature display and alarm module offers product security with a monitoring and alarm system. Real-time sample simulated temperatures are constantly displayed and supported by audible/visual high and low temperature alarms. Remote alarm dry contacts and an access port are provided to simplify connections to existing facility monitoring systems

summary:
**

These premier freestanding countertop freezers are designed in accordance with the NSF/ANSI 456 Standard for Vaccine Storage. Freezers protect pharmaceuticals at optimal temperatures, preventing waste and allowing for peak delivery.

The Premier Pharmacy Dual Temp Combination units feature separate microprocessor temperature controller allowing for precise temperature control, verification and recovery. An interior fan driven, forced-draft air circulation system provides excellent temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. REFRIGERATORS ONLY

All models are equipped with digital temperature displays for convenient monitoring. Critical samples and supplies are security backed with an extensive package of audible and visual alarms. The freezer units feature either an automatic or manual defrost operating system. For manual defrost freezers, periodic manual defrosting is required.

This model is designed with a “front-breathing” ventilation system, eliminating the need for clearance around the top and sides of the unit; enabling the user to incorporate these units into cabinets and other applications where free space is limited.

For more information on Vaccine Storage: Vaccine Storage

The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C and 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F and 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in freezers.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

product_title: 2.5 Cu. Ft. Premier Undercounter Refrigerator Freestanding
summary:
The Premier Freestanding Undercounter Refrigerators feature a microprocessor temperature controller and display, which allows for precise temperature control, verification and recovery versus mechanical style thermostats.

The 2. 5 cu.ft. capacity laboratory grade refrigerator is ideal where space is at a premium in laboratory and research environments. Enhancing its compact size, the ABT-HC-UCFS-0204 refrigerator needs only four inches of clearance on the sides and back, enabling ease in placement and optimizing workflow. This laboratory refrigerator meets ADA compliance with a total height of under 32 inches making it easily wheelchair accessible. The ADA-compliant refrigerator has all the features required for laboratory safety and security for critical cold storage in laboratory refrigeration and medical refrigeration applications.

The ABT-HC-UCFS-0204 purpose-built laboratory refrigerator is one of the most popular products within ABS’s growing Energy Star Certified portfolio. ABS undercounter laboratory refrigerators with natural refrigerants have significantly lower energy consumption compared to models using HFC refrigerants.

The Freestanding models (“UCFS”) require 4” of clearance around back and sides of the unit for proper ventilation. Improper installation will void the warranty and will lead to temperature maintenance issues, overheating and possible failure.

product_title: 12 Cu. Ft. Standard Pharmacy Solid Door Refrigerator Certified to NSF/ANSI 456
summary:
**

These standard upright refrigerators are designed in accordance with the NSF/ANSI 456 Standard for Vaccine Storage. Refrigerators protect pharmaceuticals at optimal temperatures, preventing waste and allowing for peak delivery.

These solid door refrigerators utilize microprocessor controllers and feature temperature alarms, remote alarm contacts, LED interior lighting, and probe access ports. American Biotech Supply Vaccine Storage Refrigerators utilize HFC-free refrigerant for environmental health and energy efficiency.

For more information on Vaccine Storage: Vaccine Storage
The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C and 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F and 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in freezers.

*-one or more of these certifications may apply to this unit.

summary:
**

These premier built-in undercounter refrigerators are designed in accordance with the NSF/ANSI 456 Standard for Vaccine Storage. Refrigerators protect pharmaceuticals at optimal temperatures, preventing waste and allowing for peak delivery.

The stainless steel Refrigerators utilize microprocessor controllers and feature temperature alarms, remote alarm contacts, and probe access ports with included probes. American Biotech Supply Vaccine Storage Refrigerators utilize HFC-free refrigerant for environmental health and energy efficiency.

For more information on Vaccine Storage: Vaccine Storage
The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C and 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F and 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in freezers.

summary:
Our Patented “Controlled Auto Defrost” Technology provides the convenience of an auto-defrost design while still ensuring that vaccines remain at consistent and stable temperatures below 5°F (-15°C)

Post Title: PH-ABT-HC-UCBI-0420A 4.2 Cu. Ft. Premier Pharmacy/Vaccine Undercounter Auto Defrost Freezer Built-In
product_title: 4.2 Cu. Ft. Premier Pharmacy/Vaccine Undercounter Auto Defrost Freezer Built-In
summary:
The Premier Pharmacy Built In Undercounter Freezers feature a microprocessor temperature controller and display, allow for precise temperature control, verification and recovery versus mechanical style thermostats. Critical samples and supplies are security backed with an extensive package of audible and visual alarms.

DISCLAIMER: Auto defrost freezers incorporate an electric heater installed on the evaporator that assist in the removal of the frost and ice. Although the heater helps speed up the frost and ice removal, it can raise the temperatures within the freezer

The Built-In models are designed with a “front breathing” ventilation system, eliminating the need for clearance around the top and sides of the unit; enabling the user to incorporate these units into cabinets and other applications where free space is limited.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

For more information on Vaccine Storage: Vaccine Storage

The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C to 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F to 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in the freezer.

Post Title: PH-ABT-NSF-UCBI-0404 4.6 cu. ft. Built-In Vaccine Refrigerator Certified to NSF/ANSI 456
product_title: 4.6 Cu. Ft. Built-In Vaccine Refrigerator Certified to NSF/ANSI 456
summary:
**

These premier built-in undercounter refrigerators are designed in accordance with the NSF/ANSI 456 Standard for Vaccine Storage. Refrigerators protect pharmaceuticals at optimal temperatures, preventing waste and allowing for peak delivery.

The solid door refrigerators utilize microprocessor controllers and feature temperature alarms, remote alarm contacts, and probe access ports with included probes. American Biotech Supply Vaccine Storage Refrigerators utilize HFC-free refrigerant for environmental health and energy efficiency.

For more information on Vaccine Storage: Vaccine Storage
The acceptable temperature ranges for vaccine storage are 36°F to 46°F (or 2°C and 8°C) in the refrigerator and -58°F and 5°F (or -50°C and -15°C) in freezers.

*-one or more of these certifications may apply to this unit.

product_title: 49 Cu. Ft. Premier Glass Door Chromatography Refrigerator
summary:
The Premier Chromatography Refrigerators feature a microprocessor temperature controller and display, allowing for precise temperature control, verification and recovery versus mechanical style thermostats.  One interior duplex electrical outlet and two side wall port holes are provided to simplify the setup and operation of laboratory procedures. An interior fan driven, forced-draft air circulation system provides excellent temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. All Chromatography units require two electrical outlets.

The temperature display and alarm module offers an array of robust security features with a monitoring and alarm system that is 100% independent of a microprocessor temperature controller.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

This advanced unit consumes just 1.47 KWh per day while maintaining laboratory-grade temperature control, helping you reduce operational costs without compromising performance. Post Title: ABT-HC-PLF-23 23 Cu. Ft. Premium Laboratory Auto Defrost Freezer
product_title: 23 Cu. Ft. Premium Laboratory Auto Defrost Freezer
summary:
The ABT-HC-PLF-23 Premium Laboratory Freezer delivers superior cooling performance through advanced variable speed compressor (VSC) technology. This 23 cubic foot unit provides ultra-quiet operation while achieving exceptional temperature uniformity of ±0.7°C and stability of ±1.8°C across the cabinet. With energy consumption of just 8.57 kWh per day, the system optimizes power usage by self-adjusting compressor speeds based on cooling demands.

Engineered for demanding laboratory environments, the ABT-HC-PLF-23 features microprocessor-controlled temperature management with a full array of protective alarms including power failure, sensor failure, and high/low temperature alerts. The unit maintains precise control across an adjustable range of -35°C to -15°C, with rapid pull-down to operating temperature. A 24V high-capacity battery backup ensures continuous monitoring and data logging even during power interruptions.

Built for reliability and longevity, the ABT-HC-PLF-23 is backed by a two-year parts and labor warranty and a seven-year compressor warranty. With high-density urethane foam insulation and durable white powder-coated steel construction. Five adjustable shelves with rear guard rails maximize the 23 cubic foot storage capacity, while full-coverage LED lighting provides excellent visibility. The unit arrives ready to install on four preinstalled swivel casters with front locking capability, requiring only a standard 110-120V AC connection.

Key Features

  • Variable speed compressor technology for optimized cooling
  • Ultra-quiet operation at 43 dBA or less
  • Temperature uniformity of ±0.7°C and stability of ±1.8°C across cabinet
  • Energy-efficient 8.57 kWh/day consumption with 1710 BTU/hr heat rejection
  • Seven-year compressor warranty with two-year parts and labor coverage

Benefits

  • Reduce laboratory noise pollution while maintaining superior cooling performance
  • Lower operating costs through intelligent energy consumption that self-adjusts to demand
  • Protect samples with precise temperature control and comprehensive alarm systems
  • Ensure data integrity with battery backup monitoring during power failures
  • Meet compliance requirements with ETL/C-ETL certification to UL471 standards

The unique fiberglass restricted-opening neck design of the ABS Auto Jr. reduces LN₂ consumption rates far below other auto-filling units. Under laboratory testing providing one opening per day, the ABS Auto Jr. operated and maintained “cryogenic temperatures” for over a month on one 180-liter LN₂ supply tank. Competitive units can consume three or four supply tanks per month. 

The Auto Jr is the economical auto-fill for every lab. Every Auto Jr comes standard with: 6ft. stainless-steel armor-plated transfer hose, 1/3 year parts and labor warranty, roller base, stainless steel inventory racks, and the Sentry LN2 Controller.

ABS Auto Jr. package systems are also available, including: ABS Auto Jr. Tank, Sentry LN2 Controller, stainless steel rack inventory system, transfer hose, CryoGloves, LN₂ measuring rod, and either fiberboard boxes (25 cell, 81 cell, 100 cell, or custom) or polycarbonate boxes (25 cell, 81 cell, or 100 cell).

summary:
The TempLog Premier Glass door Chromatography Refrigerators are purpose built for scientific and medical applications. Units feature a digital microprocessor temperature controller allowing for the precise temperature management necessary for critical samples and supplies. A forced air directional refrigeration system provides superior temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. An automatic cycle-defrost design prevents product damaging temperature spikes.

Real-time sample simulated temperatures are constantly displayed, logged and supported by audible/visual high and low temperature alarms, along with power outage, sensor error and door ajar alarms, remote alarm dry contacts, a 4-20mA output and an access port are provided to simplify connections to existing facility monitoring systems. A USB port is provided for easy transfer as well as software updates.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

product_title: 49 Cu. Ft. Premium Laboratory Auto Defrost Freezer
summary:
The ABT-HC-PLF-49 sets a new standard in premium laboratory freezing with its revolutionary variable speed compressor (VSC) technology, delivering ultra-quiet operation while achieving exceptional energy efficiency at just 8.69 kWh/day. This advanced refrigeration system self-adjusts to cooling demands, providing superior performance alongside significant energy savings and extended equipment lifespan. The unit maintains remarkable temperature uniformity of ±0.8°C and stability of ±2.1°C across its spacious 49 cubic foot interior, ensuring consistent conditions for your valuable samples.

Engineered for demanding laboratory environments, the ABT-HC-PLF-49 features a sophisticated Proportional Integral Derivative (PID) microprocessor controller with LCD display that maintains precise temperature control from -35°C to -15°C. The comprehensive alarm system includes visual and audible indicators for power failure, temperature sensor failure, high/low temperature, and door ajar conditions, with alarm logging capability. A 24V high-capacity battery backup keeps data logging active during power interruptions, providing continuous monitoring for your critical samples.

The ABT-HC-PLF-49 combines robust construction with thoughtful design features, including ten adjustable shelves with guard rails, double swing solid doors (right and left hinged), and full-coverage shielded LED interior lighting. The cabinet utilizes EPA-compliant high-density urethane foam insulation within a white powder-coated steel exterior, mounted on four preinstalled swivel casters with front locking capability. With an industry-leading seven-year compressor warranty and two-year parts and labor warranty, this premium freezer delivers the reliability and peace of mind your laboratory demands.

Key Features

  • Variable speed compressor technology for optimized cooling
  • Ultra-quiet operation at 43 dBA or less
  • Temperature uniformity of ±0.7°C and stability of ±1.8°C across cabinet
  • Energy-efficient 8.57 kWh/day consumption with 1710 BTU/hr heat rejection
  • Seven-year compressor warranty with two-year parts and labor coverage

Benefits

  • Reduce laboratory noise pollution while maintaining superior cooling performance
  • Lower operating costs through intelligent energy consumption that self-adjusts to demand
  • Protect samples with precise temperature control and comprehensive alarm systems
  • Ensure data integrity with battery backup monitoring during power failures
  • Meet compliance requirements with ETL/C-ETL certification to UL471 standards

Post Title: CRT-ABT-HC-10PS 10.5 Cu. Ft. Upright Controlled Room Temperature Cabinet, Solid Door
product_title: 10.5 Cu. Ft. Upright Controlled Room Temperature Cabinet, Solid Door
summary:
The Compact Controlled Room Temperature Cabinets are purpose built for medical applications. These units feature a digital microprocessor temperature controller allowing for the precise temperature management necessary for medication storage at room temperature. A forced air directional refrigeration system provides superior temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings.

A controlled temperature environment will ensure approved storage; preventing time wasted on unnecessary expense and product recalls.

Freestanding models require 4” of clearance around back and sides of the unit for proper ventilation. Improper installation will void the warranty and will lead to temperature maintenance issues, overheating and possible failure.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.

product_title: 72 Cu. Ft. TempLog Premier Laboratory Glass Door Refrigerator
summary:
The TempLog Premier Glass Door Laboratory Refrigerators are purpose built for scientific and medical applications. Units feature a digital microprocessor temperature controller allowing for the precise temperature management necessary for critical samples and supplies. A forced air directional refrigeration system provides superior temperature uniformity and recovery after door openings. An automatic cycle-defrost design prevents product damaging temperature spikes.

The Touch Screen temperature display and alarm module offers the latest in advanced temperature control and data logging.

Environmentally friendly, natural hydrocarbon (HC) refrigerants (not containing hydrofluorocarbons) vastly reduce global-warming potential (GWP) while meeting new EPA/SNAP mandates and UL, ASHRAE compliance guidelines.
